## 2026-10-12 (EOM file validation everywhere)

- **Shared checker:** `store_rankings.py` now exposes `structure(path)`, which is `validate()` without the 1st..END window check (needed for any-range exports). The rules are unchanged: Ending Loan and Inventory Base rows have 4 numbers with day == month and > 0, and the `Total:` row is not blank. `validate()` still adds the window check. All readers import it from there. Backups for every edited file: `fleet/_backups/<file>.bak-pre-eomvalid-20261012`.
- **ceo_week_pull.py:** `have()` refuses a file with the right header that fails `structure()`, and `pull()` no longer copies a degenerate export into `data/eom/`. New `resolve()` order: (1) exact range; (2) same start ending 1-2 days earlier (valid, labelled with its own end); (3) start after the 1st: derived exactly as (1st..end') minus (1st..start-1). Additive fields are subtracted, balances come from (1st..end'), and the biggest day comes from daily rows on/after start. Otherwise the range is incomplete, never estimated. Fallbacks are recorded in JSON `fallbacks` and per node `effective_range`/`source_note`. **REVENUE_2026-10-05.json rebuilt** (host queue `--no-pull`, 12:13:55, before the 12:15 brief): W and MTD come from the valid 10/10 set, and W is derived (10/1..10/10 minus 10/1..10/4). Company loans **$734,207.88**, inventory **$735,113.45** (W and MTD). This matches the corrected #store-performance post and an independent parse of the 10/10 workbooks. Revenue fields are identical to the 08:03 file, and so are the PW/LY/LYMTD nodes. max_day_sales is now filled. A 12:07 balance hot-patch preceded the rebuild (backup `fleet/_backups/REVENUE_2026-10-05.json.bak-pre-eomvalid-20261012`).
- **layaway-yield-weekly:** the 11:15 hold WAS the same file. The 10/11 Layaway block was all 0, so the compile wrote zeros and then crashed formatting a None yield (no "OK" -> hold). `freshest()` now requires every file to pass `validate()` and skips to the next older valid set, and a $0 store layaway balance counts as missing. Render on the Mac: data 2026-10-10, company $2,620.99 down + $9,057.49 payments = $11,678.48 / $97,669.36 balance = **11.96%**. The balances match store_rankings' independent parse to the cent. Live run at 12:19 **did not post**: `canvases.edit: restricted_action`, the same error that hit all 5 canvas refreshes at 09:20-09:28 today. By design, nothing posts without the canvas. Ledger row written. The post dedupe ("updated 2026-10-10", 20 h) is intact, so one re-run after canvas access is restored posts exactly once.
- **Other readers:** `store_kpis_weekly.complete_set()` now uses validate() and skips to the next older set. Today it was saved only by the dedupe against the bad 08:45 "Report Period: 2026-10-11" post. `bonus_pace.month_eom()`, `lo_outcomes_layaway.mtd_file()` and `mobilepawn_monthly.load()` skip structure() failures. `comms_engine.load_loan_balances()` (loan canvas / loan review) adds structure(); its existing `val <= 0` guard already rejected 10/11. Bonus pace revenue was NOT affected today: bonus_engine net revenue is identical on the 10/10 and 10/11 files for all 5 stores. Asset recovery does not read EOM files. `canvas_store` reads store_kpis msg files (covered upstream). `parse_eom.py` is a vendored copy kept identical to its source and is not imported in bin/, so it was left alone.
- No Bravo pulls were made.

## 2026-10-12 (store-performance bad post fix)

- **What went wrong:** the native 08:45 Monday compile posted #store-performance rankings saying "Loan Balance: all stores at $0.00", with Inventory Balance showing item COUNTS as dollars (CUL $7,536 = 7,536 items; the real figure is $193,735.31). Bad messages: parent `1791809110.099659`, thread reply `1791809110.387019` (C03CGTN3KN1). Joshua needs to delete both (the bot can't).
- **Root cause (checked against the files, not metadata):** `monday_pull.sh` pulled End of Month for 10/1..10/11 (Sunday) at 06:14. Bravo returned a **degenerate export**: right `Reporting Dates` header, but no daily rows, a blank `Total:` row, every Loan Base cell 0, Layaway block 0, and the Inventory Base day columns collapsed (3 values instead of 4). `store_rankings.py` reads by position, so it took inventory index 2 (= month QTY) as dollars and got $0 loans, $0 service charges and $0 layaway. Its only completeness check was "5 files exist, >=500 bytes", so it posted. ceo_week_pull's 07:44 and 07:56 re-pulls of 10/5..10/11 and 10/1..10/11 came back degenerate the same way, so this is Bravo's output for that window that morning, not a one-off file write. The Saturday-stamped 10/1..10/10 set (written Sun 21:43–22:07) is clean. The 10/1..10/4 Monday pull on 10/5 was also clean, so this failure comes and goes. It was not the canonical-copy logic, and the report window was right.
- **Fix (backups `fleet/_backups/{store_rankings,monday_compile}.py.bak-pre-sanity-20261012`):** `store_rankings.py` gets `validate()`: window = 1st..END; Ending Loan and Inventory Base rows have 4 numbers with day == month and > 0; `Total:` row not blank. An invalid set is skipped for the next older valid one (labelled with its own date). If none is valid: HOLD, exit 2, ledger row. Then `sanity()` withholds (exit 2 + ledger row) on any store with $0 loans or $0 inventory, $0 company service charges, or a >50% store or company loan/inventory drop vs the prior week's valid set (end-5..9 days). It tests clean on the 10/11 files (would have withheld on 18 counts) and passes on 10/4 and 10/10. New `--prefix TEXT` puts TEXT before the summary. `monday_compile.py` now tells Joshua's rollup DM that a sanity-gate hold was WITHHELD and why, instead of "held until complete".
- **Corrected post:** rendered on the Mac (identical to sandbox), checked against the 10/10 workbooks (loan, inventory, layaway, Total: row and Sales Revenue (Profit) cells read directly) and against last week (company loans $736,774.98 -> $734,207.88, inventory $724,158.77 -> $735,113.45). Retail, scrap and profit in the 10/10 and 10/11 files are identical, so stores were closed Sunday and 10/10 is the full week. Posted as Goldilocks: `1791821054.326109` ("Corrected: ... Report Period: 2026-10-10"), with the thread broadcast `1791821054.774469`.
- **10/5 post was NOT affected:** its figures match the 10/4 workbooks to the penny (loans $736,774.98).
- **#ffl-transfer-performance 09:54:17 (`1791813257.553729`) was NOT empty.** Raw `conversations.history` (new read-only `vp_slack.py raw <ch> <ts>`, backup `vp_slack.py.bak-pre-rawcmd-20261012`) shows a native Slack table block with all 5 stores plus the Total. The `text` fallback has them too. The Slack connector/reader (and clients that don't support table blocks) show only the title and summary line. Every figure checked against the five 10/1..10/12 nics-transfers CSVs: CUL $260/11, ROA $70/4, WAY $50/2, HAR $25/1, LEX $25/1, total $430/19. No repost. Still added an empty-body guard to `nics_weekly_mtd.py` (backup `.bak-pre-emptyguard-20261012`): it withholds and writes a ledger row unless there are 5 store rows plus Total.
- **Open:** `ceo_week_pull.py` validates only the Reporting Dates header, so it accepted the degenerate files. `Communcations/ceo-scorecard/data/REVENUE_2026-10-05.json` (08:03) has `loan_balance_end` 0 and `inventory_end` = item counts for W and MTD at all 5 stores. Revenue fields look right. It needs the same validate() gate, plus a rebuild before any brief uses balances. layaway-yield-weekly for 10/11 was also held this morning, probably the same files (not investigated).

## 2026-10-09 (open-error fixes)

- **Jewelry nightly 10/8 (CUL/HAR/LEX/WAY missing) — root cause: a self-inflicted watcher-restart storm, not the v3 handler.** `bravo_run` (bin/vp_lib.sh) "self-healed" (restarted the VM watcher) whenever its OWN trigger sat unclaimed >180 s — but the watcher is serial, so any trigger queued behind a running one hit that. `_restart_watcher_v2.log` shows 60+ restarts 21:17 (10/8) → 08:32 (10/9), and every jewelry run that died did so seconds after one (CUL 02:43:39, LEX 02:44:43, WAY 02:55:53, HAR 06:15:41, CUL 07:04, CUL 08:32:33 …). A killed claim is never re-run, so CSVs never landed (the CSV is written only after all 8 categories). The overnight pm-loan-growth flood (~85 triggers from 20:00) pushed the 20:43 jewelry jobs to 02:37 and multiplied the waiters. Second collision: `bravo_pull.sh`'s pre-pull health gate ran recover-to-dashboard (a separate AHK driving Bravo's screen) under a live run (10/9 08:27 during CUL), because `bravo_busy` reads the claim file's mtime (= claim time) and so calls a 10-min run "not busy" after 3 min. The ledger's "claimed backlog 18" was orphaned claims, not a queue. v3 handler itself is fine: when not killed, WAY (08:46) and CUL (09:18, 8/8 incl. the 19/19 dup-verify) completed.
  - **Fix (additive, backups `fleet/_backups/vp_lib.sh.bak-pre-selfheal-busy-20261009`, `bravo_pull.sh.bak-pre-selfheal-busy-20261009`):** new `bravo_active <min> [skip-id]` = a trigger in `triggers/claimed` whose own log was written in the last N min (same per-trigger scoping as `_watchdog.ps1`'s 2026-08-04 in-flight fix). `bravo_run` now DEFERS its self-heal while another trigger is active (logs "self-heal deferred …", resets its clock, keeps its one heal), and re-queues its own trigger once if it was orphaned. `VP_SELFHEAL_LEGACY=1` restores the old behaviour. `bravo_pull.sh` skips the health gate while the watcher is mid-run ("health gate skipped: watcher mid-run on …"). Same guard added to the two scripts that carried their own copy of the rule: `monday_pull.sh` (unclaimed-3-min self-heal) and `morning_pull.sh` (STEP 2 unconditional "watcher hygiene" restart + its STEP 5 self-heal) — backups `fleet/_backups/{monday,morning}_pull.sh.bak-pre-selfheal-busy-20261009`; both `bash -n` clean, not yet exercised live (next morning pull Sat 10/10, Monday pull 10/12).
  - **Verified live 08:52–09:24:** retry4 CUL/HAR/LEX waiters logged 13 deferrals instead of restarts while discount-review (08:50, a production daily report) and CUL ran; LEX skipped the gate during discount-review; CUL jewelry 10/8 completed 8/8 `success` (09:18:50), then HAR (09:31) and LEX (09:49) back to back with zero watcher restarts after 09:05 — all five 10/8 CSVs are now on disk (ROA 06:42, WAY 08:46). No AHK handler, saved report or watcher dispatch line was touched.
  - Unchanged / still open: HAR Charms, WAY Charms, LEX Charms+Brooches return no row total (empty categories, standing since 8/2x) — v3 records them as `error`, never 0, as designed; each costs ~5 min of polling per store. **Tonight 10/9:** `_hold_pmlg_overnight` holds 57 pm-loan-growth jobs named `20261009-2000-*`; if released at 20:00 they sort ahead of the 20:43 jewelry jobs again (delay, no longer kills).
- **False "didn't post on time: funds verification" DM (10/8 21:04)** — `fleet/expected_outputs.json` daily-funds-verification marker was `Daily Funds Verification` (the retired Cowork header); the native `bin/funds_verification.py` posts `*Funds verification — Thu Oct 8*` (receipt 18:37:47, C0B3R9B3S8H). Marker → `Funds verification` + `marker_ci: true` (matches both). Backup `fleet/_backups/expected_outputs.json.bak-pre-funds-marker-20261009`. Verified: `field_scorecard.py --dry-run` → `daily-funds-verification | OK | Thu 10/08 18:00`.
- **chekkit-ai-responder ValueError at 00:00 every night (10/3–10/9, previously marked COVERED)** — since 10/1 `send_window` is `["00:00","24:00"]`; the overnight catch-up branch (first 45 min after window open) called `strptime("24:00")` → ValueError, so the responder failed every run 00:00–00:44 and ledgered "could not read the Chekkit alert emails". Fix: skip that branch when the window is 24/7 (`hi < "24:00"`). Backup `fleet/_backups/chekkit_ai_responder.py.bak-pre-2400-fix-20261009`. Verified: repro of old line at 00:00:32 raises the exact ValueError, new guard skips; `--render --hours 2` on the Mac → `source: api | items: 0`, exit 0; heartbeat 09:20 ok.
- **fleet-doctor 10/9 "2 errors, 4 quiet" — all six were measurement artefacts, none a dead job.** Errors: `oura-daily-import` (10/06 race traceback, fixed 10/06, still inside the 12-line tail because clean runs add 2 lines) and `chrome-extension-watchdog` (event-only log; last FAILED 10/07 10:39, Claude relaunched 14:33, silent = healthy since). Quiet: `ask-vp` (.log/.out.log; logs only on questions, state.json saved every 15 s pass), `bravo-unwedge` and `scrap-closeout` (on-demand host_queue primitives, no plist), plus `chekkit-ai-responder.out.log` (empty stdout; heartbeat.json every pass). ## 2026-10-08 (Mac-first wave 1 builds)

- **Built native launchd versions of 7 Cowork tasks — all INSTALLED DORMANT.** Each wrapper sources the new `bin/vp_live.sh` and exits silently unless `fleet/state/native_live/<task-id>` exists. No live file was created: the cloud copies (claude.ai routines) of all 7 are still running and only Joshua can switch them off; going live first would double-post. To go live for one task: switch its cloud trigger off, then create the empty file `fleet/state/native_live/<task-id>`. To go back: delete it. `--render` runs call the .py directly and are never gated.
- **chekkit-unanswered-alert** (`bin/chekkit_unanswered.py morning`, wrapper `chekkit_unanswered_alert.sh`, `com.valleypawn.chekkit-unanswered-alert` Mon-Sat 08:00) and **chekkit-unanswered-eod-followup** (`chekkit_unanswered.py eod`, `chekkit_unanswered_eod.sh`, `com.valleypawn.chekkit-unanswered-eod` Mon-Sat 19:00). Source = Chekkit's own "Unanswered Message Alert" emails, read natively from Apple Mail's Envelope Index (read-only, the AI responder's method) — NOT the API: an API-only rebuild over 9/22-10/7 found ~4x more 10-minute gaps than Chekkit ever alerted on (e.g. HAR 10/5: 10 vs 0), so Chekkit's alert rule can't be reproduced from the message log. Then the SKILL's filters verbatim (sign-offs/tapbacks/emoji/empty skipped, short unclear texts judged once by vp_ai and cached, store hours with Wed = CUL+ROA and CUL/ROA Sat close 17:00, Sunday none), one count per customer text (Chekkit sometimes double-sends; 9/25 LEX). Store DMs from hr/ROSTER.json (roster_write.py --check), never Joshua/Preston. EOD matches each flagged alert to its Chekkit conversation via the API (GET only; text + 6-16 min window) instead of the dashboard; "answered" = a staff-named business text that is not automated (the "Thanks for texting ... we'll text you back shortly" greeting and the closed-hours text don't count, as in the 9/29 live run); replay cutoff 19:00. Mail freshness gate: Mail received nothing in 3 h = ledger row, no false all-clear. **Render parity:** morning summaries for 9/25, 9/28, 9/29, 10/1, 10/5, 10/6, 10/7 = the live posts' numbers exactly; DM text + recipients match the live DMs (CUL Joshua B./Rob/Sandi, WAY Chadd/Martin, HAR Walker/Camden); parity_check on 10/5 format. Morning keeps the connector's _italic_ look of the live post; EOD keeps the outbox *bold*. EOD 10/1, 10/5, 10/7 = live counts; 9/29 = live except the owner-number point below. Known difference: the 9/29 live EOD hand-excluded Joshua's own test texts; the SKILL has no such rule and the 9/30 morning counted them, so native counts them.
- **chekkit-new-review-alert** (`bin/chekkit_review_alert.py`, `chekkit_review_alert.sh`, `com.valleypawn.chekkit-review-alert` hourly :10, 09-21). ## 2026-10-06 (jewelry count fix)

- **Culpeper "same number twice" was real inventory, not a stale grid.** CUL Charms went 20->19 on 9/29 while Brooches was still 18, then Brooches 18->19 on 9/30. Since then v2's duplicate guard (GUARD 3) refused CUL every night (9/30, 10/1, 10/2, 10/5 twice) even though each category was picked, name-verified and read in its own run. The guard cannot tell a coincidence from contamination.
- **"Combo-select wedge" located.** Truncated nightly logs stop dead inside v2's report picker (cached-GUID expand/collapse, then arrow click + Focus/F4 + Focus/Alt+Down + type-ahead) or in the first grid read after it. Only the last two steps ever select anything. Today's first proving run froze at 16:43 right after "[inv-select] still no item — Alt+Down" and self-healed at 16:56.
- **Fix (additive): new `reports/JewelryCaseCountV3.ahk`, cells `jewelry-case-counts-v3` (same CSV path as v2) and `jewelry-case-counts-v3-verify` (writes `<date>_<STORE>_jewelry-case-counts-v3verify.csv` for daytime proofs).** (1) When two categories share a count, v3 re-reads each one right after a different-count category (Rings). A stale screen would show that other number, so a match proves the duplicate is real; a mismatch still fails the store with the same error text. (2) Report picking tries one arrow click + type-ahead + ClickByName + BoxReportName check first, and falls back to v2's full picker only if that does not verify. v2/v1 files untouched. `bravo_watcher.ahk` got 3 added lines (backup `bravo_watcher.ahk.bak-pre-jewelry-v3-2026-10-06`). New `_validate_watcher_v3.ps1` + allow-listed `bin/bravo_watcher_validate.sh [--restart]` (AHK /validate before any restart).
- **Verified live today (verify cell, date 2026-10-06):** CUL success 8/8 (Rings 679, Bracelets 120, Pendants 217, Charms 19, Brooches 19, Earrings 143, Chains 82, Necklaces 71; 19/19 re-read after Rings 679, confirmed genuine; 12.8 min). ROA success 8/8 (572/139/118/58/1/82/92/62; 8.7 min vs ~10.5 min on 10/5). 20 of 20 picks went through the short path, 0 fallbacks.
- **Nightly routed to v3:** block "# V3 CELL (2026-10-06)" appended to `jewelry-onhand-nightly-pull` SKILL.md via `install_skill_block.py` (block in `fleet/skill_blocks/jewelry-v3-cell-20261006.md`). It also says a v3 duplicate error must not be overridden by hand. **That task shows `enabled: false` in the scheduler as of 17:00 today; not re-enabled here.**
- **Not changed:** empty categories (HAR Charms, LEX Charms + Brooches, WAY Charms) still show status=error, never 0. The SKILL's prior-day empty rule still decides those. Each costs about 5 min per store, and the empty grid read is still a wedge risk. Nothing in Bravo can prove a zero from that screen yet.

## 2026-10-06 (missed-call weekly report native)

- **`missed-call-text-report` -> native agent `com.valleypawn.missed-call-report` (Mon 08:07)**, `bin/missed_call_report.py` + `.sh`. The Cowork task matched each text to its Chekkit conversation by hand in the website and ran out of time twice (9/28–10/4 report never posted; ledger rows 10/5 08:30 + 10/6 now RESOLVED). Now: receipts -> the agent log's "SENT <STORE> ...<last4>" line -> Chekkit API (GET only) conversations for that store whose phone ends in that last-4 -> the automated "Hi, this is Valley Pawn in ..." message within 3 min (fallback: every conversation active after the text). Replied = customer text within 24 h; store reply = first non-automated staff message (sentBy). Same DM format as the Cowork reports + the SKILL's weekly running totals / change vs prior week. "Conversations" lines use coarse topics (loan/payment, gold/jewelry, firearms, buying/selling, hours, call back) — no customer words quoted. A failed or incomplete API read = nothing posted + one ledger row; a text whose automated message is in no conversation after a complete read is reported as "didn't create a conversation (N of M matched)", as the Cowork reports did. `--render` writes/sends nothing; local sent-state file `~/Library/Logs/valleypawn/missed_call_report_state.json` prevents a second send (the bot has no im:history, so the Slack history check falls back to it).
- **9/28–10/4 report sent to Joshua once (10/6):** 120 texted, 22 replied (18%), 118 of 120 matched; 2 HAR opt-outs, 23 undelivered, 11 slow store replies (HAR most). 46 rows appended to `fleet/missed_call_text_results.csv` (74 hand rows kept untouched). **3 of the hand rows disagree with the API** (WAY 9/28 11:38 and WAY 9/29 18:45 logged "no conversation found" — the API shows replies; HAR 9/30 16:26 "no conversation" — the API shows a STOP), so the 9/28–9/30 daily DMs undercounted replies; left as-is in the file.

## 2026-10-06 (fleet-doctor quiet-job triage)

- **Ledger row 10/6 02:10 (1 erroring + 20 "quiet") triaged against plist + log + receipts + outputs: 0 dead agents.** 15 healthy but mis-measured, 4 retired/one-off leftovers, 1 real miss (mac-maintenance), 1 error already fixed (spot prices).
- **Why it cried wolf:** `bin/log_triage.py` judged each FILE alone. Most native agents leave launchd's `.out.log` empty forever and log to `<task>.log`, a `<task>/run.log` sub-folder, or only a receipt. Now a log is stale only if NONE of its agent's evidence is fresh: sibling logs (same stem / same plist / label-named log), `<stem>/run.log`, `fleet/receipts/<stem>.jsonl`, plus extras in the new `fleet/log_triage_expectations.json` (retired one-offs, aliases, extra evidence, per-log gaps, each with its reason). A `.err.log` never counts as proof of health. Also fixed: a list of `Day` entries (monthly-prestage, days 28–31) counted as daily (30h), and the dated one-shot `fwb-catchup-20261005` set forfeiture-winback's allowed gap to 40 days (one-shots are now ignored, and when two plists share a log the more frequent schedule wins). Backup `.bak-pre-quietfix-20261006`.
- **`fleet_sim.py` +6 scenarios** ("liveness evidence"): empty `.out.log` with a fresh sibling is not stale; an agent with no fresh evidence IS stale; a fresh `.err.log` is not proof of health; a receipt counts; Day-list = monthly; a retired one-off is listed, not judged. Mac: 42/42 green (mutation anchors kept). Backup `.bak-pre-quietfix-20261006`.
- **Real miss fixed: weekly Mac maintenance skipped Sun 10/4 (Mac off) and nothing would have run it until 10/11.** `catchup.py` now covers `com.valleypawn.mac-maintenance` for the rest of the week after a missed Sunday slot (evidence = `mac_maintenance.log` written since the slot). The 16:16 catch-up tick fired it: done 16:17 (TM snapshots thinned, 61GB free, health DM to Joshua). Backup `.bak-pre-macmaint-20261006`.
- `jewelry_pull_watchdog.sh` now logs its Monday skip (yesterday = Sunday, stores closed) instead of exiting silently, so a daily agent no longer shows a 41h+ gap every Tuesday 02:10. Backup `.bak-pre-mondaylog-20261006`.
- Spot prices (`vp-weekly-spot-price-update.log`, the "1 erroring job"): the error was one 10/5 run against a half-edited wrapper ("can't open '/fetch_spot_prices.py'"); the 14:46 and 10/6 07:00 runs were rc=0 and the feed page updated. Now listed as resolved. No change.
